name: Prepare For Baby
description: Guides the user through preparing for a new baby from financial planning through early developmental milestones, chaining budgeting, baby prep, home safety, career, and developmental skills across multiple categories. Use when the user is expecting a baby, preparing for a newborn, or wants a structured plan for the transition to parenthood. Do NOT use for adoption-specific processes, fertility treatment planning, or managing pregnancy health (those are medical topics).
